method: Purposive primary-source search for integrative-review case contrasts; not a systematic review or exhaustive global case inventory.
inclusion_criteria: Real district/street/schoolyard intervention with official authority or original research source
Mechanism relevant to dense urban public space, heat/water/energy or shared governance
Readable evidence or explicit limited-read flag
Distinguish implementation, observed evaluation and projected benefits
exclusion_criteria: Wikipedia, Reddit, press aggregation or consultancy commentary as factual evidence when primary material is available
Duplicate broad cases without additional mechanism
date_range: No fixed publication cutoff: original implementation records retained with current retrieval; document year and page-update year kept distinct.
engines: web search and direct primary-page/PDF reading
